Gracious and sun-filled family home with lovely developed garden & flexible living

1 Fir Lane
Web Ref. RLS1009034
Welcome to this charming family home in the heart of Tokai. Offering generous accommodation, lovely indoor-outdoor flow and a beautifully established garden. The moment that you enter through the spacious entrance area the home has a warm and welcoming feel. The open-plan lounge and dining area creates an inviting space for both relaxed family living and entertaining with a flow through to a patio featuring a retractable awning and overlooking the garden. 3 generous sized bedrooms and 2 bathrooms along with a family sized kitchen complete your picture. With the added advantage of a separate unit in the garden with an en-suite bathroom, giving you flexibility in this lovely home.

LOUNGE:
Spacious open-plan lounge with a wood/anthracite built in fireplace and a flow to patio and garden.

DINING ROOM:
The dining area is a great space for entertaining and has a feeling of space and light, it is open to the lounge and garden.

KITCHEN:
Well appointed and practical kitchen with granite countertops, a central island incorporating a ceramic hob and under-counter oven, a pantry cupboard and ample workspace.

BEDROOMS:
The sun-filled master bedroom flows to the garden and has the added luxury of a small walk-in dressing area and en-suite bathroom.
Two further comfortable double bedrooms both with built-in cupboards. One of them enjoying a direct flow to the garden.

BATHROOMS:
Family bathroom with bath, basin and toilet.
En-suite bathroom with shower, basin, and toilet.

EXTERIOR & GARDEN:
Patio off lounge with a retractable awning and flow to garden.
Extra-length automated garage provides excellent additional space for a vehicle, workshop or hobbies.
Secure off-street parking for a further two cars.
Established garden, beautifully developed and sun-filled providing a delightful outdoor setting for children, pets or simply enjoying the sunshine.

GUEST FLATLET:
Separate garden bungalow with its own en-suite bathroom - ideal space for a teenager, older child, home office or private guest accommodation.

SECURITY:
Fully alarmed.
Front garden beam.
Fully walled.
Automated gate.

Offer Rules
You will be notified of other offers via email.

All sales are non-suspensive and sold as is "voetstoots". Properties on sale with a "Offers From" price will be sold subject to confirmation of the seller. No "Offer" will be allowed to be made "ON BEHALF" unless the proxy giving a 3rd party permission is uploaded as required. No buyer can withdraw a "Offer" at any stage. The successful buyer must pay his deposit in the relevant trust accounts within 2 working days of his offer being accepted by means of EFT. No other payment method will be accepted. Outstanding balance of offer price to be delivered by means of guarantee, mortgage finance or cash. Should any dispute arise between two or more buyers, the property may be re-sold or Gemini Moon Trading 102 (PTY) Ltd T/A Seeff National Marketing Fund will declare who is the successful bidder. Gemini Moon Trading 102 (PTY) Ltd T/A Seeff National Marketing Fund shall have the right re-sell any given property if the successful buyer does not pay his deposit in the allotted time. The successful buyer cannot occupy the property prior to registration without special arrangement from the seller. Gemini Moon Trading 102 (PTY) Ltd T/A Seeff National Marketing Fund shall have the right to withdraw any property prior to the offer ending for any reason whatsoever at their discretion.
